observations: Two car headlights wrapped in clear plastic film.
The headlights have a modern, angular design with multiple horizontal light bars.
The lenses appear to be made of a dark, possibly smoked or tinted material.
The plastic housing shows some minor surface dust and reflections.
The items are resting on a cardboard surface in what appears to be a warehouse or shop environment.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrap obscures the full surface condition and the internal bulb sockets are not visible.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No Toyota logo, part number, or authenticity markings are visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The internal bulb sockets may be missing, broken, or incompatible with the vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the headlights showing the bulb holders.

risks.risk: The optical lenses may be damaged, scratched, or have internal haze.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the front lens surface and the light pattern when powered on.

risks.risk: The electrical wiring harness may be broken or have a poor connection.
risks.proof: A photo of the wiring harness and a video of the headlights working.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the headlights showing the bulb sockets.
Photo of the front lens surface to check for scratches or haze.
Video of the headlights powered on to check the light pattern.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
